pages.text: If too many $(l:zen_amphibia:lifecycle/tadpoles)tadpoles$(/l) share a small patch of water, they become stunted. Stunted tadpoles take on a sickly green tint and produce extra bubbles.

Severe overcrowding is worse: unhealthy water may show witch-like haze and smoke above the surface. Spread tadpoles into a larger pond before the weakest unnamed tadpoles fail to thrive. Healthy ponds protect your $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/breeding_goals)breeding goals$(/l).
